title: Franklin Sports Official Quikset Lacrosse Goal - 6' x 6'

reviews.title: Do not buy!
reviews.body: Do not buy this goal! It’s a pain to put together! But more than that, the quality is awful! The net is in shreds after just a month of lacrosse practice. Total waste of money.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 28, 2021
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: Good choice
reviews.body: Easy to assemble and works well
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 3, 2026
reviews.author: jason

reviews.title: Don’t Purchase
reviews.body: This goal is horrible. The screws in the back loosen with almost every shot which leads to the net ripping. After about nine months, more than half of the screws won’t even tighten anymore. The frame itself is weak and in fact, was bent by the wind. DONT RECOMMEND
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 3, 2026
reviews.author: Ashli W.

reviews.title: Great product!!
reviews.body: Took under an hour for two people to assemble, super easy but a tedious process to unscrew each screw, tuck netting under, and re-screw. Recommend a drill to attach the netting. So far, good quality. Big, official game sized net good value for money. With some of the reviews i was worried about the netting quality but seems to have held up well for a beginner middle school player. Seems pretty easy to unassemble and pack up, though it doesn’t come with a carrying case. Great product for practice/backyard solo practicing. Good to use in a game/scrimmage or with a bounce back rebounder.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 24, 2025
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: Great lacrosse goal
reviews.body: This is a great quality lacrosse goal. We have had it for a few months. We leave it out in the yard and our two sons along with many neighbor kids play with it frequently. It has held up well to rough play and the elements. Net and frame are both still in new condition. Highly recommend this product.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 15, 2024
reviews.author: Matthew Stephens

reviews.title: Perfect Lacrosse Net for Young Players
reviews.body: This is a perfect net for young players!  However, the net itself doesn’t last very long. Zip ties will be your friend!  It’s super easy to assemble and great for outside but I always say you get what you pay for. Being cheap is perfect for our family, but if left outside, you will be buying one every 2 years.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 26, 2025
reviews.author: Dianne P Grubbs

reviews.title: Cheap, don’t buy
reviews.body: Assembly is a pain, super flimsy, aluminum frame bent completely flat during a storm two weeks after we purchased.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 16, 2026
reviews.author: Josh Coleman

reviews.title: Garbage net, otherwise good investment
reviews.body: The net on this is a joke. It disintegrated in about a month or so of use. Bought another net on amazon for the goal and everything is fine. I cant speak to to its portability as it has only been set up once, but the frame has handled many bar downs, etc. and it still holding strong.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 16, 2024
reviews.author: ibuyamazon

features: 6' x 6' LACROSSE GOAL: This goal is an official regulation sized lacrosse goal perfect for both adult and youth players to practice their shooting skills

QUIKSET NET ATTACHMENT: Easily attach the netting to the goal posts by sliding the netting under the pre-attached clips and then use a screwdriver (not included) to tighten the clips to the posts and secure net in place
EASY TO ASSEMBLE: The steel posts have been made with a built in snap locking system which securely locks the posts together with ease!
NET INCLUDED: Constructed from a durable polyester with reinforced edges and a tarpaulin back pocket for secure attachment to the frame for long lasting play
ALL SKILL LEVELS: Perfect for players of all ages to use for practicing shooting accuracy, scoring and bringing endless fun to the backyard!
